{{Quote|Not to worry, ma'am. You keep that creature engaged, and I may be able to eliminate it with a clear shot.|Keth, to Janese, on Rhen Var|<ref name="ETU" />}}
'''Kres'keth'errylu''', nicknamed '''Keth''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He once teamed up with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Levat]] and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Janese]] to explore a [[Unidentified temple (Rhen Var)|temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]].

At some point, Keth played a [[Chance cube/Legends|dice]] game called [[Hintaro/Legends|Hintaro]] at an establishment<ref name="FC" /> that served as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] hideaway.<ref name="Redemption">{{FFGTCG|set=Redemption and Return|cardname=Smuggler's Hideaway|link=endor-cycle/redemption-and-return/smuggler%e2%80%99s-hideaway-r1747}}</ref> The [[Hunting/Legends|hunter's]] opponent was<ref name="FC" /> an old-model [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Both players had large stacks of gaming chips in front of them and had set down their weapons on the table they were playing at&mdash;a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in Keth's case and a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] lodged into the table's surface on the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] side. Both the Chiss and the droid were standing up while playing the game, with an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] carrying [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] glasses on its dome-shaped head also present at the table. At one point during the game, the droid playing against Keth rolled a set of five [[Color/Legends|red]] dice on the table, with the hunter watching the throw intently.<ref name="FC" />
